text:
Maya: Quick morning poll — what's your go-to toast topping? defend your choice. pics welcome :bread:
Liam: Avocado. salt, lemon, chili flakes. can't be beat.
Sofia: Peanut butter + honey. protein and nostalgia. crunchy > smooth.
Ethan: Butter + flaky sea salt. classical. heat the plate, melt the butter.
Priya: Hummus + sliced tomato + za'atar. savory & filling. works with an egg on top.
Riley: Nutella. dessert for breakfast. 10/10, fight me. :chocolate_bar: 
Tom: Greek yogurt + berries on thick sourdough — it's like a deconstructed parfait.
Maya: Okay this is already a mood. Should we do a 1-min poll? react with :avocado: for avo, :peanut: for PB, :butter: for butter, :chocolate_bar: for Nutella, :hummus: for hummus, :blueberries: for yogurt.
Liam: :avocado:
Sofia: :peanut:
Ethan: :butter:
Priya: :hummus:
Riley: :chocolate_bar:
Tom: :blueberries:
Maya: Tallying results... close race. Lunch table debate incoming. :laughing:
